prompt: A country road at night in the 1920s, a 16:9 picture filling the frame edge to edge. A roadside beer hijack: a flat-bed truck stopped hard behind a fake police roadblock, its load spilled, wooden barrels split open across the road. Knee-high and on a 40mm lens, we are level with a clean-shaven man of about sixty, gaunt and hollow-cheeked, in a dark uniform tunic and peaked cap, crouched beside a burst barrel, head and shoulders big in the left of the frame, turned three-quarter toward the truck, mouth open mid-word. The truck's amber headlamps light his lips and jaw. Violet bulbs on a shuttered filling station hang behind him. A sheet of spilled beer covers the road, doubling amber and violet in its foam-flecked surface. Thanks.
